phrases.latin: Mox in ecclēsiam ībimus; calceōs indue.
phrases.english: We’re going to church soon; put your shoes on.

phrases.latin: laetātus sum in hīs quae dicta sunt mihi: in domum Dominī ībimus
phrases.english: I was glad when they said to me, “We will go into the house of the Lord”

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 173, 291.
